name: Agent sandbox (NVIDIA OpenShell)
description: Runs an AI agent (a harness, installed by a harness feature such as opencode-harness) in an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox that holds no credentials and reaches only the local model, the workspace's data and the Workbench tools, as the administrator's ai-policy.yaml allows. Installs the openshell CLI, the agent-sandbox command, the base policy files and the sandbox-broker scripts in /opt/agent-sandbox. Needs the ai-policy feature, and an app whose compose file runs the OpenShell gateway and the broker.

username.description: Username of the container user, who runs the sandbox commands.

userHomeDir.description: Home directory of the container user: where the sandbox state (openshell/) and downloads live (APP_USER_HOME at run time).

role.description: app: the container the user works in; every command is sent to the broker named in AGENT_BROKER. broker: the sandbox-broker image, which also gets sshd and runs the commands against the gateway.

openshellVersion.description: NVIDIA OpenShell CLI release to install. The app's gateway and sandbox runtime images must be the same release.

openshellSha256.description: SHA-256 of the openshell-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz archive of that release.
